calls.summary: The team discussed a comprehensive overhaul of the SDK caching system aimed at improving scalability and maintainability. They decided to implement per-SDK connection caches to resolve issues related to MongoDB's document size limit and streamline payload management. The new caching approach reduces CPU and memory usage by eliminating on-demand transformations. Migration efforts revealed bugs that were addressed, and the team emphasized future strategies for large customer support through API-based data fetching and environment tagging. Careful deployment practices, including parallel cache writing and schema versioning, were introduced to enhance robustness. The existing AWS Marketplace purchasing process remains manual due to low volume.
